title: SMART
description: SMART health and wear of every drive on every physical host, the NUCs, Pis and Voyager, the one to replace first at the top. docs/design/host-monitoring.md.

panels.title: Most worn drive
panels.description: The drive with the highest wear: endurance used for an SSD, power-on hours against a 5-year life (43,800 h) for a hard disk; the table's Basis column says which. Orange from 80 %, red from 100 %.

targets.expr: topk(1, max by (instance, device) (smartctl_device_percentage_used{job="smartctl"}) or max by (instance, device) (smartctl_scsi_percentage_used_endurance_indicator{job="smartctl"}) or max by (instance, device) (100 - smartctl_device_attribute{job="smartctl", attribute_name=~"Wear_Leveling_Count|Percent_Lifetime_Remain|Media_Wearout_Indicator", attribute_value_type="value"}) or max by (instance, device) (smartctl_device_power_on_seconds{job="smartctl"} / 3600 / 43800 * 100 and on (instance, device) smartctl_device_rotation_rate{job="smartctl"} > 0))

panels.title: Wear 80 % or more
panels.description: Drives at or past 80 % wear, by the same measure as the table: endurance used for an SSD; a hard disk counts by age, power-on hours against 43,800 h (5 years).

targets.expr: count((max by (instance, device) (smartctl_device_percentage_used{job="smartctl"}) or max by (instance, device) (smartctl_scsi_percentage_used_endurance_indicator{job="smartctl"}) or max by (instance, device) (100 - smartctl_device_attribute{job="smartctl", attribute_name=~"Wear_Leveling_Count|Percent_Lifetime_Remain|Media_Wearout_Indicator", attribute_value_type="value"}) or max by (instance, device) (smartctl_device_power_on_seconds{job="smartctl"} / 3600 / 43800 * 100 and on (instance, device) smartctl_device_rotation_rate{job="smartctl"} > 0)) >= 80) or vector(0)

panels.title: Errors
panels.description: Drives with NVMe media errors, reallocated, pending or uncorrectable sectors, SCSI grown defects or uncorrected read or write errors.

targets.expr: count(group by (instance, device) (smartctl_device_media_errors{job="smartctl"} > 0 or smartctl_device_attribute{job="smartctl", attribute_name=~"Reallocated_Sector_Ct|Current_Pending_Sector|Offline_Uncorrectable", attribute_value_type="raw"} > 0 or smartctl_scsi_grown_defect_list{job="smartctl"} > 0 or smartctl_read_total_uncorrected_errors{job="smartctl"} > 0 or smartctl_write_total_uncorrected_errors{job="smartctl"} > 0)) or vector(0)

panels.title: Failing health
panels.description: Drives whose own SMART health check fails, or whose NVMe critical warning is set.

targets.expr: count(group by (instance, device) (smartctl_device_smart_status{job="smartctl"} == 0 or smartctl_device_critical_warning{job="smartctl"} > 0)) or vector(0)

panels.title: Not reported
panels.description: Drives expected but silent now: seen by SMART in the last 7 days, a node's boot drive (sda or nvme0n1), or one of Voyager's disks in its collectd stream.

targets.expr: count(max by (instance, device) (label_replace((topk by (instance, device) (1, max by (instance, device, model_name) (last_over_time(timestamp(smartctl_device{job="smartctl"})[7d:10m]))) or on (instance, device) last_over_time(max by (instance, device) (label_replace(label_replace({__name__=~"servers_Voyager_local_disktemp_.+_temperature"}, "device", "$1", "__name__", "servers_Voyager_local_disktemp_(.+)_temperature"), "instance", "voyager", "", ""))[7d:1h]) or on (instance, device) label_replace(group by (instance, device) (node_disk_info{job="node-exporter", instance!~"k8s-.*", device=~"sda|nvme0n1"}), "device", "$1", "device", "(nvme[0-9]+)n[0-9]+")) * 0 + 1, "dashboard", "homelab-host-$1", "instance", "(.+)")) unless on (instance, device) group by (instance, device) (smartctl_device{job="smartctl"})) or vector(0)

panels.title: Every drive
panels.description: Every drive on every host, the one to replace first at the top: sorted by Health (Failing, then Errors, then OK), then by Wear, with drives not reporting last. Wear means two things. For an SSD it is the drive's own endurance used (NVMe percentage used, or 100 minus a SATA SSD's normalised wear attribute): 100 % is the rated write endurance spent, and the drive may run well past it. A hard disk reports no such figure, so its Wear is power-on hours against a 5-year life (43800 h), the warranty term of NAS and enterprise drives: a generic figure, not this drive's datasheet. A hard disk's real warning sign is Bad sectors (reallocated, pending and offline-uncorrectable, or SCSI grown defects) rising, which puts it in Errors whatever its age. Basis says which Wear a row has. A drive seen in the last 7 days, a node's boot drive, or one of Voyager's disks in its collectd stream that reports nothing now stays listed as Not reported with its last values. A Voyager disk in standby when the exporter restarts reads Not reported until it wakes. Written is NVMe and SCSI only.
